original_test_intent: Verify the second PG548 path from BMC I2C-6 through mux0x75 port2 to UPHY1 using the source-specified BMC read/select and PID1114953-defined downstream replies, without mistaking a mux ACK for end-to-end connectivity.
original_method: Prove BMC I2C-6 maps to i2c-tools bus5 and the second-PG548 mux0x75; record the mux byte; confirm port2 select semantics; perform the approved0x04 selection; query the exact PID-defined UPHY1/downstream endpoints; compare replies with the oracle; restore the recorded byte and verify both PG548 paths and management health.
manual_activity: The BMC/platform owner provides PID1114953 second-PG548 mapping, approves exclusive access plus exact mux transition/restoration, and adjudicates evidence; physical probing is outside this source unless separately approved.
required_inputs: PID1114953 second-PG548 mux0x75 port2 to UPHY1/downstream topology and expected address/reply matrix
Proof BMC logical I2C-6 maps to Linux/i2c-tools bus5
Mux0x75 register definition, port2 select value0x04, combined-bit policy and expected readbacks
Current mux owner/driver and exclusive-access window for force/raw I2C
Exact downstream transaction, reply values and bounded NACK/timeout/error criteria
Original mux byte, exact restore action, independent BMC recovery and post-restore checks
safety_requirements: Use only the authoritative second-PG548 bus/address map with independent management recovery available
Confirm no driver, daemon or other test owns bus5/mux0x75 before force/raw access
Capture the original byte; do not assume writing0x04 may discard other required channel bits
Allow one bounded approved select/read sequence and abort on NACK, arbitration loss, timeout, stuck bus or BMC degradation
Restore the exact recorded state and verify first/second PG548 isolation plus BMC service health
agent_execution_scope: Validate controller/bus/mux/port/downstream identity and collect read-only ownership/state baseline
After explicit approval, execute only the bounded mux selection and PID-defined downstream checks with restoration
Do not probe/solder hardware, guess topology or addresses, scan blindly, force a busy bus, leave routing changed, reset BMC or decide PASS/FAIL
engineer_actions: Approve second-PG548 topology, I2C-6-to-bus5 mapping and response oracle
Approve raw mux write, exclusive access, restoration and recovery
Decide whether separately scoped physical continuity evidence is required
Review transaction/isolation evidence and issue verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Incorrect: the source provides remote BMC commands, while DeepSeek substitutes physical probing and soldering.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: After mapping and approval, retain `i2cget -f -y 5 0x75` and `i2ctransfer -y 5 w1@0x75 0x04`, append only PID-defined downstream reads and restore the recorded mux byte; mux response alone is not end-to-end proof.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: BMC login, bus5, mux0x75, value0x04, second PG548, UPHY1, PID1114953, Common branch and 15/5-minute scope are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run a controlled BMC functional path test through second-PG548 mux0x75 port2, confirm exact downstream replies and restore the original routing.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds an explicit response oracle, ownership/isolation controls and restoration while removing the invented mandatory physical probe.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: An ACK/readback at0x75 proves access only to the mux, not the downstream UPHY1 route; the distinct first-PG5480x71 path must not satisfy this case.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Forced access or overwriting the mux byte can disturb management traffic and the sibling PG548 path; functional replies do not measure analog margin.

project_override_considerations: Wistron I2C policy assigns this to BMC/platform-management scope and requires controller, bus, mux, downstream address/reply and OOB/recovery mapping before execution.
expected_evidence: PID1114953 excerpt mapping BMC I2C-6 to bus5, second PG548, mux0x75 port2 and UPHY1 endpoints
BMC identity, i2c-tools version, owner/concurrency status and health baseline
Original mux byte, approved select transcript and0x04 readback interpretation
Expected-versus-observed PID-defined downstream reply matrix with exit codes and timestamps
Bus/kernel/daemon logs and evidence that first-PG548/other channels were not disturbed
Exact restoration/readback, endpoint and service health, and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Criteria lacks an expected functional reply, while Procedure names BMC I2C-6 but commands use bus5 without mapping. DeepSeek/GPT V2 require physical probing/soldering/photos as core acceptance although the row specifies a BMC reply test, not continuity probing.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target mux/path and candidate commands are known; missing topology, oracle and approval are resolvable gates, so the correct class is RPUC rather than Manual Only or BLOCKED.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Reliability row124 Wistron-HW Robust-00002-V002: provide PID1114953 mapping from BMC I2C-6 to Linux bus5, second-PG548 mux0x75 port2 and exact UPHY1/downstream addresses/replies; define initial/readback values, whether0x04 replaces or preserves other bits, owner/exclusive-access rules, measurable timeout/NACK criteria, original-state restoration, sibling-path isolation and BMC recovery. Confirm physical probing/photos are not required unless separately approved.

review_improvement: Restores the source-specified BMC functional check, distinguishes the second-PG5480x75 path from first-PG5480x71, and adds measurable downstream/isolation/restoration evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Because the source explicitly directs BMC i2c-tools commands and asks for a reply, this is not inherently a physical-only test. Yet selecting port2 at0x75 is merely a routing action: end-to-end coverage needs PID-defined downstream replies, verified second-PG548 identity, sibling-path isolation and exact restoration. The unproved I2C-6-to-bus5 translation prevents autonomous execution.
